sql: SELECT CAST(MAX(t1.footage_duration) - MIN(t1.footage_duration) AS REAL) * 100 / MIN(t1.footage_duration) FROM roles AS t1 INNER JOIN film AS t2 ON t1.film_id = t2.film_id WHERE t2.heading = 'Batman'

SELECT t1.label FROM performer AS t1 INNER JOIN roles AS t2 ON t1.thespian_id = t2.thespian_id INNER JOIN film AS t3 ON t2.film_id = t3.film_id WHERE t3.debut_time = '2015-10-26' AND t2.billing_rank = 1
